scenes.title: The operating gap
scenes.narration: In a food-production facility, a fan can report running while exhaust remains below the configured target. Open Soom connects that difference to an actionable, traceable response.

scenes.title: A shared operating path
scenes.narration: Device adapters publish a common observation contract to a real one M two M platform. Discovery, subscriptions, group queries, and access policies support one shared operating path.

scenes.title: See the facility respond
scenes.narration: The dashboard keeps every zone visible. This recorded interactive demo starts with a cooking-line fault, sends a permitted damper command, and then displays the observed recovery.

scenes.title: AI with an evidence trail
scenes.narration: The same tools are available through a Codex plugin and a standalone model runner. Here, real model-generated calls discover equipment, inspect evidence, request action, and verify the result.

scenes.title: Close the verification loop
scenes.narration: A command is only the beginning. The device must acknowledge it. Two fresh later observations must meet the facility profile before open Soom records a verified recovery.

scenes.title: Keep unresolved outcomes visible
scenes.narration: When the damper opens but airflow does not recover, the incident stays unresolved. An acknowledgement never becomes a success claim. The evidence remains available for follow-up.

scenes.title: Reusable beyond one facility
scenes.narration: Food production is one reference profile. A learning facility and a second vendor format use the same core, with their own targets, units, and permitted controls.

scenes.title: Open-source adoption
scenes.narration: Open source means easier adoption. Replay the local demo, use Codex workflows, and inspect the evidence.

scenes.title: Room to breathe
scenes.narration: Open Soom. Real software. Virtual equipment. Open-source air operations. Explore the code.
